notes.title: The game will be taken down indefinitely.
notes.content: [p]To Our Esteemed Players,[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past two-plus years, it has been the development team’s great honor to have earned your favor.[/p][p][/p][p]This project’s development was fraught with hardships. It may not be perfect—for the creators, it even carries memories they’d rather not revisit. It was born amid countless doubts, pushed forward by an unyielding obsession, concluded amid the exhaustion of a rookie team, and finally launched out of a desperate longing to hold onto it. It began with a dedication to art, passion for storytelling, and eagerness to create; it witnessed the youth and confusion of a group of people who were themselves gamers, and stands as an unpolished confession of our hearts.[/p][p][/p][p]Yet it remains a beautiful chapter of time in our minds, and a unrefined answer sheet from a group of people who dreamed of making games.[/p][p][/p][p]If this work has brought you even a sliver of new experience—no matter how you look at it—please remember: it also came from a group of gaming enthusiasts. Someday, you might become a creator too. May your journey be filled with joy and enthusiasm.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, the team members have gone their separate ways. The revenue from this launch has been meager, but we are grateful to every player who took the time to experience our work. We offer our most sincere thanks.[/p][p][/p][p]All available revenue from this work will be donated to public welfare projects.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to issues regarding the ownership of the work’s rights, we will take this project off the shelves in the coming days.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, if we ever get another chance, we hope to bring more bright and hopeful stories to this world.[/p]
